title: sdks: unify auth/retries + streaming ergonomics across python/ts/go; parity fixes & version bumps
author: Asha Patel
description: Motivation: user reports and internal audits showed divergent behavior between the Python, TypeScript, and Go SDKs for two areas: 1) auth token refresh/retry behavior under transient 401/429, and 2) streaming APIs ergonomics (client-side backpressure and reconnect semantics). This PR unifies auth+retry semantics across SDKs, improves streaming ergonomics, applies parity fixes discovered during testing, and bumps client versions. Summary of changes: unified retry policy with configurable backoff and max attempts; standardize auth token refresh hook and credential expiry handling; streaming client improvements (reconnect with resume token, explicit close semantics, improved type annotations/Docs); parity fixes for errors and edge-case handling observed in e2e runs; version bumps for Python/TS/Go packages and changelogs. Backwards compatibility: default behaviors are kept conservative (defaults match prior behavior where possible), but new opt-in knobs are exposed for aggressive retry/backoff and streaming resume. Migration notes: SDK consumers who implemented custom retry/auth hooks should migrate to the new hook signatures (one-line adapter examples provided in SDK docs). Checklist: - [x] Python SDK changes implemented and unit-tested - [x] TypeScript SDK changes implemented and unit-tested - [x] Go SDK changes implemented and unit-tested - [x] Cross-SDK e2e smoke tests passed - [x] Docs updated and examples added - [x] Version bumps and changelogs prepared
